CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS book_quote_staging (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    author VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    quote TEXT NOT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(100),
    batch_index INTEGER,
    batch_size INTEGER,
    raw_emotions TEXT[],
    emotion_labels TEXT[],
    embedding vector(768),
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'collected',
    needs_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    error_reason TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
    processed_at TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE(title, author)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_book_quote_staging_status
ON book_quote_staging (status, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_book_quote_staging_category
ON book_quote_staging (category);

SELECT id, title, author, quote, category, raw_emotions, emotion_labels
FROM book_quote_staging
WHERE status = 'review_pending'
ORDER BY processed_at NULLS FIRST, id
LIMIT 10;

UPDATE books
SET emotion_labels = ARRAY[{{ $json.emotion_labels.map(e => "'" + e.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::TEXT[]
WHERE title = '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  AND author = '{{ $json.author.replace(/'/g, "''") }}';

UPDATE book_quote_staging
SET emotion_labels = ARRAY[{{ $('재검토 응답 파싱').item.json.emotion_labels.map(e => "'" + e.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::TEXT[],
    status = 'done',
    needs_review = FALSE,
    error_reason = NULL,
    processed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('재검토 응답 파싱').item.json.id }};
